consumed_evidence: All V1–V5 cohorts, including 910000..910047, and V6 smoke/diagnostic runs are consumed development evidence. Only the separately reserved V6 confirmation cohorts provide independent confirmation. No checkpoint selection or adaptation uses confirmation.

crowd.rule: Render guarded new student only after independent terrain qualification; otherwise label raw fallback. Retain failures.

rules: Complete matched inventory; every policy/sensor condition meets unchanged goal targets with zero falls or invalid outcomes and no goal regression versus baseline.

Both candidates require per-condition goal/fall nonregression and a strict aggregate goal/fall gain against their declared reference. The model candidate additionally requires at least 5% useful command influence; its reference uses the identical budget recovery.

Choose one global eligible controller by goals, restricted completion time, then declaration order. Confirmation cannot reselect. A nonmodeled winner does not establish incremental world-model benefit.
Report recovery exposure and layout-clustered finite-sample safety. Zero observed falls does not establish absolute reliability.

navigation_recovery.planner: Existing A* on observed lidar occupancy; model authority disabled during recovery.
navigation_recovery.trigger_inputs: Visited positions and elapsed time; budget_watchdog hands off no later than one third of the unchanged episode deadline.

prior_evidence.navigation: V5 selected and reference each reached 282/288 goals with zero falls. One per-condition regression failed the selected model gate. All six selected misses were late-recovery timeouts.
prior_evidence.terrain: V5 initial and DAgger each reached 91/96 goals with zero falls. Initial gains versus raw84/projected83 failed Holm significance. V4 DAgger aggregate gain remains evidence, but all-terrain qualification failed. Short original teacher trajectories omitted late-step and settling states.

residual_guard.rule: Zero for reverse/lateral/pure-yaw/low-forward commands; linear gain from .15 to .3 m/s; unchanged projected nominal reference and joint limits.

scope: 12-DoF BHL MuJoCo prototype. Navigation uses simulator pose and goal plus observed lidar occupancy for latched map recovery; no true maze topology. Terrain uses privileged simulated heights. MPC supplies bounded joint-residual labels for distillation; this is not a replacement of the frozen RL base gait or a real-robot validation.

storage.cache_policy: Reuse frozen checkpoints/data; no installs; TMPDIR=/tmp; bytecode disabled.

rules: Retain joint limits, residual caps, zero-residual candidate and frozen simulation physics.

Require informative late-contact labels across at least two fresh training trajectories, finite inference, improvement over initial/zero on new training labels, and legacy mild test improvement over zero before physical development.
terrain_learning.scope: New trajectories are train-only; original mild-terrain calibration/test groups are unchanged reused diagnostics. New-label imitation is training evidence only; physical development and independent confirmation are mandatory.

terrain_primary.hypothesis: A new MPC-distilled bounded student improves fresh moderate-terrain goals beyond raw gait and projection without per-terrain regression.
rules: Training qualification precedes development. Development requires a clean candidate, per-terrain nonregression versus projected and guarded_initial, and a strict net goal gain over guarded_initial.
Independent confirmation includes 192 matched geometry/reset cases per arm. Candidate has zero falls, off-course outcomes, numerical failures and target guard errors.

Each terrain reaches at least the goal count and 95% progress of both controls; strict paired goal gains must pass two-sided exact discordant-pair tests with Holm correction across the two primary controls.
Guarded initial/DAgger comparisons are secondary and reported separately. No confirmation checkpoint selection, adaptation or deadline changes. Failed cases retain 40s restricted completion time.
Only an independent primary pass permits the severity-1 challenge. Navigation qualification is independent.

terrain_supervisor.scoring: Unchanged V3 stable-goal threshold: cross-track and heading below .15 for .8 seconds; same controller on every arm.
